name: telos
intro: direction: what you are here to do, and what you are working toward

mission.interview: Still the reason you're doing this? Anything sharpen it?
mission.first: What are you here to do?
lenses: If you had to explain why this matters to someone who just met you, what would you say?
What would feel like failure, even if everything else went fine?
mission.draft: Is this the reason you're doing this?

goal.first: What are you working toward, and by when?
lenses: What would you be proud to have done by this time next year?
What keeps coming back to you as something you mean to get to?
goal.draft: Is this the goal as you would put it?

problem.interview: Still in your way? Changed shape?
lenses: What keeps coming back up no matter what you try?
If this weren't a problem anymore, what would look different?
problem.draft: Is this still what's in your way?

challenge.interview: Still true? Still hard for the same reason?

strategy.interview: Still the plan? Has the evidence changed it?

ideal.interview: Still where you want to end up on {dimension}?

decision.interview: The revisit date passed. Did the prediction hold?
